description: This is a localization file for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, providing Lithuanian translations for various interface strings.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user should remove a certain number of characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user should type more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selectable elements.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search is in progress.
